waivers.reason: The project owner explicitly approved Scanner 2.0.0-rc.8 for production on 2026-08-20 without providing the planned new owner-private locked capture session. The 300-image and 115-image results remain development evidence.

The project owner explicitly selected a permanently keyless Scanner 2.0 Catalog policy on 2026-08-20. File-level SHA-256 verification remains mandatory, while HMAC authentication is not part of the operating contract.

remaining_limitations: This release has no independent generalization estimate; the 300 and 115 images remain development and calibration lineage.
Checksum-only Catalog validation detects accidental corruption but does not authenticate who modified the Catalog and checksum file.
The long-term APPROVED target of 99% was not met on the 300-image development set; observed APPROVED was 90% over all judgeable GT.
Future Store Catalogs remain checksum-only unless the project owner explicitly changes the public operating contract.
